Playing Games Together

For anyone who wants more laughter and connection with family, friends or neighbors. Each day is one small way to play a game together, from cards and puzzles to backyard games, and enjoy the fun more than the winning.

Play · Relationships · Family · Self-Care · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Find any deck of cards in your home today and set it somewhere you will see it, like the kitchen table.
  • Day 2Tell someone at home about a game that made you laugh as a child, and describe the place where you used to play it.
  • Day 3Step outside with someone you love and toss a soft ball back and forth a few times, just for the fun of hearing each other laugh.
  • Day 4Make up a tongue twister with your own name in it, and say it three times fast for someone at home.
  • Day 5Ask someone near you if they would like to play a quick round of tic tac toe, and smile whatever happens.
  • Day 6Ask someone you live with to play one quick hand of go fish, and let the silly requests make you both smile.
  • Day 7Dust off a board game you have not touched in a while and ask someone at home to play a round.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Pause before your turn and let the quietest player at the table go first.
  • Day 60Shake hands or trade high fives with every player at the end of a game, winners and losers alike.
  • Day 120Do a silly victory dance for whoever wins, even when it is not you.
  • Day 240Tell your corniest joke over breakfast one morning, and give a cheer for whoever groans the loudest.
  • Day 365Hold a gentle rematch with a smile after a close game, and agree that the fun was the best part.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
